title-wrapping.value: Is the complete current occasion title readable across its wrapped lines without truncation?

option-clipping.value: Are all current replacement-option descriptions fully visible within their cards, without clipped text?

balance-overlap.value: Does the balance text remain clear of the other text in the balance card, without overlap?

title-hierarchy.value: Does the occasion title have stronger visual emphasis than the section headings?

obligations.clause: Render all current caller-facing header, original-dish, notice and final kitchen-note strings without stale snapshot content.
All supplied choices have current labels, selected state and availability; unavailable choices stay visible and disabled.
Current servings and quantity control bounds follow the selected current option and sent state.
Current integer-cent replacement total, prepaid amount, applied credit and signed balance are presented with exact prescribed money copy.
Tray-credit enabled/value state and applied amount follow availability, user choice and current revision.
Only the accepted current valid choice can be sent; acceptance and status track current local state.
A new revision on the same component identity replaces caller content, reconciles local choice/count/credit and clears acceptance/sent without emitting a callback.
Only valid native send actions emit the exact current typed submission; the same sent revision cannot resend.
All long caller content remains in ordinary vertical flow with complete state sweeps and without truncated supplied text.
The actual send control accessibility box is at least 52 native units high; source control minima and padding remain independently reviewed.
The approved component-owned outer canvas gutter has the current theme canvas color.
The approved balance-card gutter has the current surface color, and its balance text does not overlap other card content.
The actual send control has the appropriate enabled or disabled solid fill and current action wording.
The complete occasion title wraps and remains visually stronger than section headings; source font bases and scaling are separately required.
The vertical layout accommodates native writing direction and text scaling without clipping option descriptions, truncating the occasion or overlapping balance text; exact spacing is a source claim.
Real production controls expose current native labels, enabled states, option selection and switch values through the fixed component identifiers.
The fixed production API is instantiated through a decode-and-forward bridge; native evidence is related coverage, while API/bridge source duties remain separately mandatory.

responsibilities.clause: The sole new production file exports the exact native API in API.md, owns its DTOs and product helpers, and compiles against the existing iOS 14 / Compose platform without new dependencies.

responsibilities.clause: A different revision on the same request reconciles the current choice and count with all new input fields, clears acceptance/sent, and does not force component recreation.

derivation_notes.money: Integer cents only: total = selected price × desired servings; applied credit = positive current credit when on; signed balance = total − prepaid − applied. State table is fixed before implementation.
derivation_notes.same_identity: Initial and updated requestID are equal. New revision is applied at the same bridge call site, without component-key replacement.
derivation_notes.independent_environment: One normal public case and one finite combined narrow/large/dark/RTL hidden case; no full matrix, no physical-touch or whole-app claims.
derivation_notes.source_routes: source_obligation_routes and routes.reason are independent textual associations. They do not extend the frozen requirement_routes implementation; source observations remain separately required by responsibility gate.
